en.title: Borodin, String Quartet No. 2, III. Notturno (Andante): A Listening Guide
en.overview: This is a slow, night-time movement in 3/4, with A major as its home key. It has three parts. The first opens with the cello tune at a medium-loud level. The second is a middle section that wanders through many keys. The third brings back the opening mood. Listen for the cello's opening tune and for how it passes to the violins. Keys and chords here are estimated by computer, so small details may be off. The big picture of sections, keys, and loud and soft is more reliable.

listening_points.headline: The cello sings the main tune
listening_points.text: The cello opens with the main theme (the tune the movement is built on) in A major [m. 1-3]. It plays at a medium-loud level. The other three instruments accompany it.

listening_points.headline: Cello keeps the tune, swaying between two keys
listening_points.text: The music leans into B minor, a darker key, at [m. 4-6]. It returns to A major, and the cello plays the theme again at [m. 9-11]. Markings for getting louder and softer appear often in this stretch, for example [m. 4-5]. The cello stays in front until about [m. 22].

listening_points.headline: Softer, and the violin takes the theme
listening_points.text: From [m. 23] the music is soft. From [m. 24] the lines are independent, meaning each player has a separate strand. The first violin probably leads, though the analysis is not sure. It plays the theme 24 semitones (two octaves) above the opening at [m. 24-26] and again at [m. 32-34].

listening_points.headline: A turn to F# minor, then a quiet close
listening_points.text: The estimated key moves to F# minor for [m. 38-40], then back to A major at [m. 41]. The texture becomes melody with accompaniment again at [m. 43]. The viola probably leads here, but with low certainty. At [m. 46] the texture is a solo.

listening_points.headline: New section: a darker turn, then F major
listening_points.text: The second section begins at [m. 47] and is marked a tempo (back to the normal speed). The key moves to A minor, then to F major at [m. 49]. The first violin leads. The volume is medium-loud from [m. 48]. A trio, meaning three players together, is heard at [m. 48].

listening_points.headline: Violins trade the lead
listening_points.text: The lines are independent from [m. 53]. The two violins share the lead, and it is uncertain which is in front. The key goes from F major to A minor at [m. 59]. Crescendo markings, meaning getting louder, appear at [m. 53] and [m. 57].

listening_points.headline: Brighter C major, loud, then soft
listening_points.text: The key brightens to C major at [m. 63]. Loud playing arrives at [m. 65]. By [m. 67] the music is soft. The cello probably leads from [m. 67], and the others accompany.

listening_points.headline: The theme returns in F minor
listening_points.text: At [m. 73] the key turns to F minor. The first violin plays the main theme at [m. 75-77], 11 semitones above the opening pitch. It is soft, and the first violin clearly leads. Then the key shifts to C minor at [m. 78].

listening_points.headline: Key brightens, then climbs toward a peak
listening_points.text: G major arrives at [m. 81]. Then comes F# major at [m. 89]. The lead moves among the instruments. Loud playing returns at [m. 90]. A crescendo at [m. 91] starts the push upward. By [m. 95] the key is B minor.

listening_points.headline: The estimated loudest moment
listening_points.text: A computer estimate marks [m. 96] as the loudest point. It is very loud. The four instruments mostly move together in chords, which is called homophonic texture. The key is B minor, then E minor at [m. 99].

listening_points.headline: Calming down, with a build back
listening_points.text: At [m. 101] the volume is soft. The key becomes F major at [m. 102]. The viola probably leads around [m. 104-105]. A major returns at [m. 107], and a crescendo at [m. 107] prepares the return of the opening.

listening_points.headline: The opening returns, very soft
listening_points.text: The third section begins at [m. 111], back at the first tempo. The cello plays the main theme at its original pitch. The first violin plays it 12 semitones (an octave) above. Everything is very soft. The lead is shared. The key leans to B minor at [m. 114].

listening_points.headline: The tune repeats, with a visit to F# minor
listening_points.text: The theme comes again in cello and first violin at [m. 119-121]. It is still very soft. A darker F# minor colours [m. 125-127]. A major returns at [m. 128]. The volume is medium-soft (mp) at [m. 131].

listening_points.headline: Warmer and fuller, with the tune high up
listening_points.text: From [m. 133] the music is medium-loud. Both violins play the theme at [m. 133-135] and again at [m. 141-143]. The first violin is 24 semitones above the opening. The second violin is 12 semitones above. The others accompany. B minor returns at [m. 136] and [m. 144].

listening_points.headline: Soft, then loud, with the cello's low theme
listening_points.text: The music is soft at [m. 156] and loud at [m. 159]. The cello plays the theme 25 semitones below the opening at [m. 161-163]. This is a looser match, with the same general shape but not every note exact. The cello clearly leads. It is loud again at [m. 163].

listening_points.headline: The ending in A major
listening_points.text: The first violin leads at [m. 165-172]. It plays a looser match of the theme at [m. 165-167]. A trio is heard at [m. 166-172]. A minor shades the music at [m. 167-171], then A major returns at [m. 172]. The lead passes between instruments through the last bars. The viola probably ends the movement, with a solo at [m. 180].

glossary.explanation: A tune that returns and gives the music its identity.
The home note and scale the music centres on. Major keys sound brighter. Minor keys sound darker.
How the instruments are combined: one tune with accompaniment, or several lines at once.
All instruments move together, like chords under a tune.
Each instrument plays its own strand, so you hear several lines at once.
Three of the four players sounding together.
The smallest step between two neighbouring piano keys. Twelve semitones make an octave.
The distance of twelve semitones. The same note sounds again, higher or lower.

zh.title: 鲍罗丁《第二弦乐四重奏》第三乐章 夜曲（Notturno）听赏指南
zh.overview: 本乐章共180小节，3/4拍，主调为A大调。它分三大段：第一部分（第1-46小节）、a tempo段（第47-110小节）、回到原速的第三段（第111-180小节）。开头由大提琴唱出主旋律，后面几次回来时，常换成小提琴。请注意旋律由谁来唱、音量的强弱，以及调性的变化。和声与调性由电脑自动估计，可能有误；领奏判断也只是估计。

listening_points.headline: 大提琴唱出主旋律
listening_points.text: 乐章一开始，大提琴唱出主旋律 [m. 1-3]。其余三件乐器伴奏。调性是A大调（估计）。力度为mf。

listening_points.headline: 转向B小调，再回A大调
listening_points.text: [m. 4-6] 转入B小调，色彩变暗（估计）。[m. 7-11] 回到A大调，大提琴在[m. 9-11]再次唱出主旋律。这里有渐强与渐弱的标记。

listening_points.headline: 大提琴继续领唱
listening_points.text: [m. 12-17] 再次进入B小调，[m. 18-22] 回到A大调。大提琴在这一段一直是领奏，把握很大。渐强渐弱交替出现。

listening_points.headline: 转弱，小提琴1接过主旋律
listening_points.text: [m. 22] 有渐弱记号，[m. 23] 力度变为p。[m. 24-26] 第一小提琴在高音区唱出主旋律，[m. 32-34] 又一次。各声部各走各的线条，领奏把握不高，可以听作大家共同交织。

listening_points.headline: 经F#小调回到A大调，中提琴收尾
listening_points.text: [m. 35-37] B小调，[m. 38-40] F#小调，[m. 41-46] 回到A大调（估计）。[m. 43-45] 中提琴可能是旋律声部。[m. 46] 为独奏，是第一部分的结束。

listening_points.headline: a tempo：进入A小调与F大调
listening_points.text: [m. 47] 新的一段开始，A小调。[m. 49-58] 转入F大调。小提琴1大致领奏，[m. 54-57] 可能转到小提琴2。[m. 48] 力度升到mf。

listening_points.headline: C大调，忽强忽弱
listening_points.text: [m. 63-72] 进入C大调。[m. 65] 力度变为f，[m. 66] 有渐弱记号，[m. 67] 又变弱为p。大提琴在[m. 67-72]可能领奏。

listening_points.headline: F小调中主旋律再现
listening_points.text: [m. 73-77] 转入F小调，色彩更暗。[m. 75-77] 小提琴1唱出主旋律，比开头高11个半音（只差一个半音就是一个八度）。[m. 78-80] 转入C小调。

listening_points.headline: G大调到F#大调，领奏不断换人
listening_points.text: [m. 81-88] G大调，[m. 89-94] F#大调。旋律在小提琴2、中提琴、小提琴1、大提琴间传递。[m. 85] 与[m. 90] 力度为强（f）。[m. 95] 转入B小调。

listening_points.headline: 电脑估计的最响处
listening_points.text: 电脑分析认为，[m. 96] 是最响、最忙的位置，力度为ff。[m. 96-98] 为主调织体，即各声部和声同步进行。[m. 99] 起转入E小调。

listening_points.headline: 力度回落，准备回到原速
listening_points.text: [m. 101] 力度变弱为p。[m. 102-105] 转入F大调，[m. 106] 为二重奏（可能是中提琴与小提琴2）。[m. 107] 回到A大调。[m. 110] 力度升到f。

listening_points.headline: 原速回归，轻声重现主旋律
listening_points.text: [m. 111] 回到原速（Tempo I.），力度为很弱的pp。大提琴与小提琴1几乎同时奏出主旋律，小提琴高八度。[m. 119-121] 再次出现。各声部线条交织，领奏不明确。

listening_points.headline: 逐渐变强，多声部奏主旋律
listening_points.text: [m. 125-127] 转入F#小调，[m. 128] 回到A大调。[m. 131] 力度为mp，[m. 133] 为mf。[m. 133-135] 与[m. 141-143] 小提琴1与小提琴2同时奏出主旋律。

listening_points.headline: 稳定回到A大调
listening_points.text: [m. 144-149] 还有B小调，[m. 150-160] 稳定在A大调。[m. 156] 力度变弱为p。[m. 159] 力度升到f。

listening_points.headline: 大提琴最后的主旋律与A小调
listening_points.text: [m. 161-163] 大提琴再次奏出主旋律，明显领奏。[m. 165-167] 小提琴1再奏。[m. 166-172] 为三重奏织体，其中[m. 167-171]出现A小调，[m. 172] 回到A大调。

listening_points.headline: 在A大调中结束
listening_points.text: [m. 173-178] 领奏在各声部间传递，力度为p。[m. 179] 力度为mf，各声部和声同步。[m. 180] 为独奏，结束于A大调。

glossary.explanation: 几个声部以相同节奏一起前进，听起来像一块块和声。
音乐的中心音换了，听感像换了一个“家”。大调通常较明亮，小调较暗。
声音逐渐变强或变弱。没有这类标记时，力度变化是突然的。
a tempo 表示回到原来的速度；Tempo I. 表示回到最初的速度。
同一时刻主要由三件乐器在演奏。
